## Problem Statement

A clear and concise description of the problem you're facing. What are you trying to do that JoyVoice doesn't support today?

*Example: I want to transcribe audio in real-time, but JoyVoice only supports file-based input.*

## Proposed Solution

A clear and concise description of what you'd like to see implemented.

## Alternatives Considered

Have you considered any workarounds or alternative approaches? What were their limitations?

## Use Case

Describe how this feature would be used. Who benefits and in what scenario?

## Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, references, or screenshots about the feature request here.
